numbers.sentence: Early stopping was implemented based on the validation set for regularisation and gradient clipping was set to 1. All the hidden layer sizes were set to 50, and all the weights were randomly initialised between -0.3 and 0.3 including word embeddings.

Early stopping was implemented based on the validation set for regularisation and gradient clipping was set to 1. All the hidden layer sizes were set to 50, and all the weights were randomly initialised between -0.3 and 0.3 including word embeddings.
As can be seen in Table , the average subjective success rate was 98%, which means the system was able to complete the majority of tasks.
Based on this domain, we ran 3000 HITs (Human Intelligence Tasks) in total for roughly 3 days and collected 1500 dialogue turns.

assumptions.sentence: Although in this work we focus on text-based dialogue systems, we retain belief tracking at the core of our system because: (1) it enables a sequence of free-form natural language sentences to be mapped into a fixed set of slot-value pairs, which can then be used to query a DB.
assumptions.anchorText: Although in this work we focus on text-based dialogue systems, we retain belief tracking at the core of our system because: (1) it enables a sequence of free-form natural language sentences to be mapped into a fixed set of slot-value pairs, which can then be used to query a DB.
